en.title: The World Tree and the tower
en.description: A vast grassland surrounds the World Tree and a lone magic tower.

ko.title: 남겨둔 빵
dialogue: 핀: “두 개 있잖아.” / 미라: “둘 다 내 거야.”

en.title: Breakfast
en.description: Finn joins Mira for breakfast on the terrace.

ko.title: 오늘은 뭐 해?
dialogue: 핀: “그다음은?” / 미라: “네가 조용히 해주면 알 것 같아.”

en.title: Plans for today
en.description: Finn chats while Mira tries to read.
dialogue: I might find out if you'd let me read.

en.title: Hold this, too
en.description: Mira uses a physical spell card to hold a book and napkin against the wind.

en.title: After breakfast
en.description: Professor Orin calls the two students to his office.
dialogue: Come to my office after breakfast.

en.title: Two field assignments
en.description: Orin sends Mira to the World Tree and Finn to the stone golem village.
dialogue: Mira, go to the World Tree.
Finn, go to the stone golem village.

ko.title: 가서 무엇을 볼까
dialogue: 핀: “이 정도 크기입니까?” / 오린: “크기도 직접 확인한다. 추측으로 채우지 않는다.”
핀: “가서 발자국도 봐야겠다.” / 미라: “난 정령들이 어디서 자는지 궁금해.”

en.title: What to look for
en.description: The students ask about their research. Orin insists on direct observation.
dialogue: Where they live. How they move.
I wonder where the spirits sleep.

ko.title: 오후의 준비
dialogue: 핀: “그걸 다 가져가?” / 미라: “아직 고르는 중이야.”
미라: “그림 많이 그릴 거면 이것도.” / 핀: “아, 고마워.”
핀: “이 정도면 메겠어?” / 미라: “응. 훨씬 낫다.”

en.title: Packing
en.description: Mira and Finn help each other pack for the journey.
dialogue: If you'll be sketching, take this too.

ko.title: 다음 날 아침
dialogue: 핀: “책 몇 권 남겼어?” / 미라: “반은 뺐어.”
오린: “안전이 우선이다. 잘 보고 오면 된다.” / 미라·핀: “다녀오겠습니다.”

en.title: The next morning
en.description: Orin sees them off the following morning.
dialogue: How many books did you leave?

ko.title: 갈림길
dialogue: 핀: “저녁에 돌아와서 맥주나 마시자.” / 미라: “좋아. 먼저 오면 기다려.”

en.title: The fork in the road
en.description: They promise to have a beer together that evening, then take separate paths.
dialogue: Let's have a beer when we're back tonight.
Deal. Wait for me if you're first.

en.title: The stone golem village
en.description: Finn approaches the golems' rocky habitat, greets them and begins observing.
dialogue: So that's the stone golem village.

en.title: Footprints
en.description: Finn studies deep footprints. A small golem peers at his notebook.

en.title: A rolling pebble
en.description: Finn and a small golem roll pebbles. A pebble rolls under a slab.

en.title: Out of reach
en.description: The golem and Finn cannot reach the pebble by hand.
dialogue: I can't reach it by hand.

en.title: Just this stone
en.description: Finn draws a spell card and asks the small golem to stand back.
dialogue: I'll just lift this stone a little.

en.title: Got it
en.description: Finn lifts the stone with a card. The small golem retrieves its pebble.

en.title: Another round
en.description: The golem rolls its pebble back to Finn, asking to play again.
dialogue: Oh. You want to play again?

en.title: Mok
en.description: Finn names his new companion Mok.

en.title: First notes
en.description: Finn sketches Mok and shows him the drawing.
dialogue: Stay like that for a moment.

en.title: No answer
en.description: Mok's eyes turn red. He ignores Finn and walks toward a dark cave.
dialogue: Shall we call it a day?
